_metadata.description: Chatbot / live-chat vendors for higher education. Signatures data-mined from the rendered HTML of BuiltWith 'Chatbot'-labeled cohort-128 homepages (UNI-156 Phase 3): each scripts/html regex targets the vendor's dedicated widget host or a widget-specific marker, empirically deduced from the vendors' own positive corpus, not hand-guessed. RECALL IS SYSTEMICALLY LOW FOR THIS CATEGORY: this corpus is homepage-only (one captured page per institution, no /library or portal subpages), and the majority of pos-miss institutions load their chat widget through a Google Tag Manager container (2-4 gtm.js containers observed on every sampled miss) or another consent/tag-manager gate, so the vendor's own script never appears in the captured static HTML even though BuiltWith found it live. neg_hit_pct is consistently ~0-0.7% and spot-checks confirm those are BuiltWith's OWN misses (real installs), not false positives from these dedicated-host signatures — so precision is high even where recall is low. Treat low recall_pct here as a corpus-coverage ceiling, not a signature-quality problem.
_metadata.source: data-mined from local corpus/ (Wasabi-fetched cohort-128 rendered HTML) vs institutions.tech_profile BuiltWith Chatbot labels, via scripts/mine-local.js (deduce->validate harness, UNI-156)

LiveChat.description: LiveChat (Text s.c.) live-chat widget, loaded from cdn.livechatinc.com (or the newer livechat-static.com CDN).
LiveChat._validation: Data-mined vs BuiltWith Chatbot (UNI-156, 2026-07-16). 'livechatinc.com'/'livechat-static.com' home-page HTML = 16.0% recall over 125 positives-with-HTML (20 hit); 37 neg-hits over 4089 negatives (0.9%), spot-checked as BuiltWith misses (real cdn.livechatinc.com/tracking.js installs). Low recall: most pos-miss institutions load the widget via a GTM container not resolved in the captured static HTML.

Zendesk.description: Zendesk Web Widget (chat/messaging), loaded from static.zdassets.com — distinct from a bare *.zendesk.com help-center link.
Zendesk._validation: Data-mined vs BuiltWith Chatbot (UNI-156, 2026-07-16). 'zdassets.com' home-page HTML = 4.2% recall over 120 positives-with-HTML (5 hit); 14 neg-hits over 4094 negatives (0.3%), spot-checked as BuiltWith misses. Deliberately excludes bare '<inst>.zendesk.com' help-center links (Zendesk Guide), which are common in HE IT-support footers but are a different product from the chat widget and would flood false positives.

Intercom.description: Intercom Messenger widget, loaded from widget.intercom.io / js.intercomcdn.com.
Intercom._validation: Data-mined vs BuiltWith Chatbot (UNI-156, 2026-07-16). 'widget.intercom.io'/'intercomcdn.com' home-page HTML = 3.8% recall over 104 positives-with-HTML (4 hit); 2 neg-hits over 4110 negatives (0%), spot-checked as BuiltWith misses. Low recall consistent with GTM-gated loading on the pos-miss set.

tawk.to.description: tawk.to free live-chat widget, loaded from embed.tawk.to.
tawk.to._validation: Data-mined vs BuiltWith Chatbot (UNI-156, 2026-07-16). 'tawk.to' home-page HTML = 37.6% recall over 117 positives-with-HTML (44 hit) — the best recall of any non-HE-specific vendor; 5 neg-hits over 4097 negatives (0.1%), spot-checked as BuiltWith misses (real embed.tawk.to installs).

Zopim.description: Zopim (Zendesk Chat v2) widget, loaded from v2.zopim.com. Zendesk acquired Zopim; where a site fires this it is running the legacy embed rather than the current Zendesk Web Widget.
Zopim._validation: Data-mined vs BuiltWith Chatbot (UNI-156, 2026-07-16). 'v2.zopim.com' home-page HTML = 2.8% recall over 109 positives-with-HTML (3 hit); 0 neg-hits over 4105 negatives (0%). Low recall consistent with GTM-gated loading on the pos-miss set; 0% neg-hit confirms the dedicated host is not a prose false-lead.

LibraryH3lp.description: LibraryH3lp reference-desk chat widget, loaded from libraryh3lp.com (or a regional subdomain, e.g. ca.libraryh3lp.com). Higher-ed-specific: this is the dominant library-reference chat platform.
LibraryH3lp._detection_note: HE-priority vendor kept despite low recall: LibraryH3lp is deployed almost exclusively on library subdomains/portal pages, not the institution homepage, and this corpus captures one homepage per institution (no /library subpage). Real-world multi-page crawls (deTECHtor's own strategicPaths includes '/library') should recover far more hits than this homepage-only measurement shows.
LibraryH3lp._validation: Data-mined vs BuiltWith Chatbot (UNI-156, 2026-07-16). 'libraryh3lp.com' home-page HTML = 3.3% recall over 123 positives-with-HTML (4 hit); 3 neg-hits over 4091 negatives (0.1%), spot-checked as BuiltWith misses (real libraryh3lp.com/js/libraryh3lp.js installs).

Salesforce Live Agent.description: Salesforce Embedded Service / Live Agent chat widget. Fingerprinted via the salesforceliveagent.com host, the 'embeddedservice' bootstrap token, the esw.min.js loader filename, or the X-Salesforce-CHAT cookie name (surfaced in cookie-consent tables). Deliberately excludes the bare word 'salesforce', which collides with the Font Awesome 'fa-salesforce' brand-icon CSS class present on almost every site using Font Awesome.
Salesforce Live Agent._validation: Data-mined vs BuiltWith Chatbot (UNI-156, 2026-07-16). Combined signature home-page HTML = 10.5% recall over 105 positives-with-HTML (11 hit); 16 neg-hits over 4109 negatives (0.4%), spot-checked as BuiltWith misses. A naive bare 'salesforce' token was rejected: it hit 33% of positives but was matching the Font Awesome brand icon class 'fa-salesforce' in page CSS, not the chat widget.

Rocket.Chat.description: Rocket.Chat self-hosted live-chat widget, identified by its standard livechat loader filename (rocketchat-livechat[.min].js) served from the institution's own Rocket.Chat instance. Excludes the bare word 'rocketchat', which collides with the Font Awesome 'fa-rocketchat' brand-icon CSS class.
Rocket.Chat._detection_note: Very thin positive evidence (1 confirmed hit) — Rocket.Chat is self-hosted with no single dedicated CDN host, so this filename-based signature is the only durable marker found. Kept at reduced confidence rather than deferred because the marker is unambiguous where it fires (0% neg-hit) and a naive bare-word alternative was ruled out as a Font Awesome collision.
Rocket.Chat._validation: Data-mined vs BuiltWith Chatbot (UNI-156, 2026-07-16). 'rocketchat-livechat' home-page HTML = 0.9% recall over 111 positives-with-HTML (1 hit); 0 neg-hits over 4103 negatives (0%).

ServiceNow.description: ServiceNow customer-service/IT portal (service-now.com), commonly the campus IT help-desk/self-service front door; frequently ships a Virtual Agent chat widget within that portal.
ServiceNow._detection_note: Homepage links to the institution's service-now.com portal are a strong proxy for a ServiceNow deployment, but do not on their own confirm the Virtual Agent chat widget specifically vs. the ITSM self-service portal generally.
ServiceNow._validation: Data-mined vs BuiltWith Chatbot (UNI-156, 2026-07-16). 'service-now.com' home-page HTML = 15.4% recall over 78 positives-with-HTML (12 hit); 24 neg-hits over 4136 negatives (0.6%), spot-checked as BuiltWith misses (real <inst>.service-now.com portal links).
